title_cn: 政府推进数字平台整治 督促大型平台降低佣金
summary_cn: 政府官员要求大型数字平台（如叫车、外卖等）披露佣金「GP」结构，并在竞争委员会禁涨6个月的背景下继续降低费率。此举源于骑手、商户、餐馆对平台收费过高的投诉。目前已有3家头部平台承诺降低佣金。

title: Small firms urge overhaul of water management
desc: The Federation of Thai SMEs has called on the government to urgently overhaul the country's water resource management for long-term sustainability, while revamping disaster relief mechanisms to ensure transparency and fairness for affected Thais.
title_cn: 泰国中小企业呼吁全面改革水资源管理体系
summary_cn: 泰国中小企业联合会敦促政府紧急改革国家水资源管理制度，以实现长期可持续发展，同时要求完善灾难救济机制，确保对受灾民众的透明公平救助。
desc_original: The Federation of Thai SMEs has called on the government to urgently overhaul the country's water resource management for long-term sustainability, while revamping disaster relief mechanisms to ensure transparency and fairness for affected Thais.

title: Carbon capture and usage regulations take shape
desc: Thailand is laying the groundwork for carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS) projects by developing the rules and governance needed to support the sector, aiming to curb emissions and accelerate the shift to a low-carbon economy.
title_cn: 泰国制定碳捕获利用与储存部门规管框架
summary_cn: 泰国正制定碳捕获、利用和储存「CCUS」项目所需的规则和治理框架，旨在减少碳排放，加快向低碳经济转变。这是泰国推进绿色产业发展的重要举措。
desc_original: Thailand is laying the groundwork for carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS) projects by developing the rules and governance needed to support the sector, aiming to curb emissions and accelerate the shift to a low-carbon economy.

title: EV import taxes set to rise in January
desc: The Finance Ministry is preparing to raise excise taxes on imported electric vehicles (EVs) by early 2027 to encourage automakers to establish EV production facilities in the country.
title_cn: 泰国计划明年初提高进口电动车消费税
summary_cn: 泰国财政部计划于2027年初提高进口电动车消费税，以激励汽车制造商在泰国建立电动车生产基地。此举旨在保护和鼓励本地EV产业发展。
desc_original: The Finance Ministry is preparing to raise excise taxes on imported electric vehicles (EVs) by early 2027 to encourage automakers to establish EV production facilities in the country.

title: Tourism officials eager to tap Asia's stars
desc: Thai tourism officials plan to intensify efforts to increase arrivals from artificial intelligence (AI)-driven economies and neighbouring countries with strong GDP growth, focusing on Taiwan, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia and Singapore, according to the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT), citing an International Monetary Fund (IMF) forecast released last week.
title_cn: 泰国旅游部门瞄准亚洲高增长市场拓客
summary_cn: 泰国旅游局计划加强对台湾、马来西亚、越南、印度尼西亚和新加坡等人工智能驱动经济体和GDP增长强劲国家的旅游营销，以吸引更多游客入境。该计划以国际货币基金组织最新预测为依据。
desc_original: Thai tourism officials plan to intensify efforts to increase arrivals from artificial intelligence (AI)-driven economies and neighbouring countries with strong GDP growth, focusing on Taiwan, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia and Singapore, according to the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT), citing an International Monetary Fund (IMF) forecast released last week.

title: Floods spur debate over city pond plan
desc: Severe flooding in Bangkok in late September has reignited a dispute over the proposed Bueng Khu Bon retention pond, raising questions about whether the capital should build more large-scale water-retention facilities or prioritise improvements to existing drainage systems.
title_cn: 洪灾掀起蓄水池计划争议
summary_cn: 9月底曼谷遭遇严重洪灾，再次引发城市防洪策略的激烈争议。核心分歧在于曼谷是否应建造更多大规模蓄水设施如布翁库邦（Bueng Khu Bon）蓄水池来应对洪水，还是优先改善现有排水系统。这场争议反映了城市面对气候变化和洪灾防御的战略难题。
desc_original: Severe flooding in Bangkok in late September has reignited a dispute over the proposed Bueng Khu Bon retention pond, raising questions about whether the capital should build more large-scale water-retention facilities or prioritise improvements to existing drainage systems.

title: Democrats prepare lawsuit over Bangkok flood claims
desc: The Democrat Party is preparing to sue the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration and other state agencies in the Administrative Court over alleged negligence in handling floods in the capital, seeking full compensation for affected residents.
title_cn: 民主党就曼谷洪灾提起诉讼
summary_cn: 泰国民主党向曼谷都市政府及相关政府部门向行政法庭提起诉讼，指控存在应对洪灾的失职和过失行为。民主党要求政府为受灾居民提供全额赔偿。这一诉讼成为检视政府灾害应对能力和行政问责的重要案例。
desc_original: The Democrat Party is preparing to sue the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration and other state agencies in the Administrative Court over alleged negligence in handling floods in the capital, seeking full compensation for affected residents.

title: Thai debt outlook differs vastly from France
desc: Although public debt is climbing in Thailand, it is still a far cry from France's position, where public debt has reached 117-119% of GDP, says an international economics analyst.
title_cn: 泰国债务形势远优于法国
summary_cn: 国际经济学家指出，尽管泰国公共债务不断上升，但与欧洲主要经济体仍有巨大差距。法国公债已达国内生产总值（GDP）的117%-119%，而泰国债务水平远低于此。这一对比表明泰国的债务形势相对可控。
desc_original: Although public debt is climbing in Thailand, it is still a far cry from France's position, where public debt has reached 117-119% of GDP, says an international economics analyst.

title: Ex-Democrat MP slams online gambling crackdown
desc: Former Democrat Party MP Sirichok Sopha has questioned the effectiveness of the Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry's crackdown on online gambling, claiming major websites remain accessible despite the blocking of nearly one million URLs.
title_cn: 前议员质疑在线赌博打击效果
summary_cn: 前民主党议员四立奇·索帕（Sirichok Sopha）公开质疑数字经济与社会部（DES Ministry）打击在线赌博的成效。他指出，该部门虽封禁近100万个网址，但主要赌博网站仍可访问。这一评论反映了政府网络监管措施存在的执行漏洞。
desc_original: Former Democrat Party MP Sirichok Sopha has questioned the effectiveness of the Digital Economy and Society (DES) Ministry's crackdown on online gambling, claiming major websites remain accessible despite the blocking of nearly one million URLs.

title: Govt watching Europe unrest
desc: The Commerce Ministry is closely monitoring protests and unrest across Europe to assess potential risks to Thai trade and exports, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said on Sunday.
title_cn: 泰国政府密切监测欧洲局势
summary_cn: 泰国商务部正在密切跟踪欧洲各地的抗议活动和社会动荡，评估其对泰国贸易和出口的潜在风险。副总理兼商务部长苏帕杰·苏通蓬（Suphajee Suthumpun）表示，政府需要主动应对全球局势变化。这反映了泰国对国际贸易环境的前瞻性关注。
desc_original: The Commerce Ministry is closely monitoring protests and unrest across Europe to assess potential risks to Thai trade and exports, Deputy Prime Minister and Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun said on Sunday.

title: Govt plans Prachin Buri River probe
desc: A thorough investigation is needed to determine what caused aquatic animals to die in the Prachin Buri River, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said.
title_cn: 政府将调查普拉钦布里河生物死亡事件
summary_cn: 普拉钦布里（Prachin Buri）河近日发生水生动物大规模死亡，政府副发言人拉利达·佩尔斯维瓦塔纳表示需要进行彻底调查以确定原因。这类环境污染事件可能涉及工业排污或农业化学物质泄漏，事关水源安全和生态保护。
desc_original: A thorough investigation is needed to determine what caused aquatic animals to die in the Prachin Buri River, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said.

title: Tougher rules for parcel delivery firms
desc: The new postal law could mean parcel delivery firms in Thailand face tighter rules and scrutiny on several issues.
title_cn: 新邮政法对快递公司施加更严格监管
summary_cn: 泰国新邮政法将对快递物流企业实施更严厉的监管要求和审查措施。这些规定可能涉及运营标准、安全规范、消费者保护等多方面内容，或将提高物流企业的合规成本，最终影响快递服务价格和质量。
desc_original: The new postal law could mean parcel delivery firms in Thailand face tighter rules and scrutiny on several issues.

title: Public 'not convinced' by welfare policies
desc: Some 64.85% of respondents lack confidence in the Anutin Charnvirakul government's welfare provision, with others saying Thais have limited access to state benefits, a Suan Dusit Poll survey has found.
title_cn: 民众对政府福利政策信心严重不足
summary_cn: 塔信民调（Suan Dusit Poll）最新调查显示，约65%的泰国受访民众对阿努廷·查尔维拉古（Anutin Charnvirakul）政府的福利政策缺乏信心，多数认为普通民众获得政府社会保障的途径和覆盖范围都很有限。这反映出政府在社会保障政策执行方面面临严峻的信任危机。
desc_original: Some 64.85% of respondents lack confidence in the Anutin Charnvirakul government's welfare provision, with others saying Thais have limited access to state benefits, a Suan Dusit Poll survey has found.

title: Crypto market unfazed by protests
desc: Protests spreading across Europe have had limited impact on Bitcoin thus far, but if the unrest turns into a wider European bond or equity sell-off, it could weigh on risk appetite across assets, including cryptocurrencies, says the Thai unit of Binance.
title_cn: 欧洲抗议对全球加密市场影响暂时有限
summary_cn: 币安（Binance）泰国分支指出，欧洲多地抗议活动目前对比特币等加密资产冲击有限。但该机构警告，若抗议升级为欧洲债券和股票大规模抛售，则可能打击全球风险资产投资信心，进而波及加密货币等高波动资产的价格走势。
desc_original: Protests spreading across Europe have had limited impact on Bitcoin thus far, but if the unrest turns into a wider European bond or equity sell-off, it could weigh on risk appetite across assets, including cryptocurrencies, says the Thai unit of Binance.

title: Opposition to discuss censure plan
desc: Opposition parties are scheduled to meet on Wednesday to discuss the timetable for a no-confidence debate, with the Democrat Party insisting it needs at least four days to grill the government.
title_cn: 反对党就不信任案辩论日程展开协商
summary_cn: 泰国反对党定于本周三召开协调会，商讨针对政府的不信任动议（censure motion）的辩论时间安排。民主党坚持需要至少四天时间充分质询政府。这一举措表明泰国政治对立进一步激化，政府稳定性面临挑战。
desc_original: Opposition parties are scheduled to meet on Wednesday to discuss the timetable for a no-confidence debate, with the Democrat Party insisting it needs at least four days to grill the government.

title: Retail sector targeted for overhaul
desc: The Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) is ramping up its oversight of the country's retail sector to promote fair-trade practices and enhance the competitiveness of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
title_cn: 零售业改革整顿启动
summary_cn: 泰国贸易竞争委员会（TCCT）正加强对国内零售业的监管力度，旨在推动公平贸易实践，提升中小企业（SME）的市场竞争力。此举有助于规范零售市场秩序，保护中小零售商的合法权益，促进行业的可持续健康发展。这是泰国优化经济结构、实现包容性增长的重要举措。
desc_original: The Trade Competition Commission of Thailand (TCCT) is ramping up its oversight of the country's retail sector to promote fair-trade practices and enhance the competitiveness of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

title: Govt insists border  artefacts are Thai
desc: Culture Minister Sabeeda Thaised has rejected Cambodia's demand for the return of artefacts found at Prasat Khana on the Thai-Cambodian border, insisting the items are Thai antiquities protected under Thai law.
title_cn: 泰国政府坚持边界古物所有权
summary_cn: 泰国文化部长沙比达·泰塞德拒绝了柬埔寨要求归还在泰柬边界普剌撒特卡那（Prasat Khana）发现的文物的要求，并强调这些物品是受泰国法律保护的泰国古董文物。这一立场反映了两国在边界地区文化遗产归属问题上的长期分歧，也凸显了该地区古迹保护与所有权问题的复杂性。
desc_original: Culture Minister Sabeeda Thaised has rejected Cambodia's demand for the return of artefacts found at Prasat Khana on the Thai-Cambodian border, insisting the items are Thai antiquities protected under Thai law.

title: Pressure mounts over sea ruling
desc: Thailand should endorse the 2016 South China Sea Arbitral Award to protect its maritime trade interests, preserve regional peace and uphold the maritime framework Unclos, says former Philippine Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio.
title_cn: 泰国面临南海仲裁案认可压力
summary_cn: 菲律宾前最高法院法官安东尼奥·卡皮奥表示，泰国应认可2016年南海国际仲裁案的裁决，以保护自身的海上贸易利益、维护地区和平并遵守《联合国海洋法公约》（UNCLOS）的国际海事法律框架。这一建议涉及泰国未来的海外贸易战略、东南亚地区外交政策以及国家的长期安全利益。
desc_original: Thailand should endorse the 2016 South China Sea Arbitral Award to protect its maritime trade interests, preserve regional peace and uphold the maritime framework Unclos, says former Philippine Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio.

title: Power banks top banned items in Thailand’s checked baggage
desc: Power banks top banned items in Thailand’s checked baggage Legacy Power banks have emerged as the most common banned items found in checked baggage at Thai airports since new baggage inspection rules took effect on October 16, according to the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT). The aviation regulator reported the findings yesterday, October 25, after reviewing the implementation of the new measures, which allow airport security personnel to open suspicious checked bags without passengers being present. CAAT said it also detected battery-powered electronic devices during screening. Such equipment can pose fire and short-circuit risks if stored or transported incorrectly, particularly in an aircraft’s baggage hold. Passengers are prohibited from packing power banks in checked baggage and must instead carry them in their hand luggage, subject to capacity and quantity restrictions. Under CAAT’s separate power bank regulations introduced earlier this year, passengers may carry up to two power banks, with devices rated above 100 watt-hours requiring airline approval if they do not exceed 160 watt-hours. title: Thailand weather today, 26 October: heavy rain in 49 provinces, Bangkok heavy rain
desc: Thailand weather today, 26 October: heavy rain in 49 provinces, Bangkok heavy rain Legacy Heavy rain is forecast in 49 provinces today, with the South and the South’s west coast hit hardest. The North, Northeast, Central and East regions also face rain. Nakhon Si Thammarat, Phatthalung, Songkhla, Surat Thani, Satun and Trang face very heavy rain. Bangkok can expect scattered thundershowers with gust wind and isolated heavy rain, with highs reaching 35°C. A high-pressure system from China is extending over the upper country and the South China Sea. It is pushing easterly winds that carry moisture toward the upper country and upper South. A monsoon trough across the middle South is strengthening, driving continuous and heavy to very heavy rain there. Bangkok The capital faces scattered thundershowers with gust wind and isolated heavy rain today. Lows of 24-27°C and highs of 33-35°C are expected, with southeasterly winds of 10 to 20km/h. North Scattered thundershowers with gust wind and isolated heavy rain are forecast across Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Lamphun, Lampang, Phayao, Nan, Uttaradit, Sukhothai, and Tak. title: CP distances itself, chairman from holy basil patents
desc: Charoen Pokphand Group (CP), the country’s largest agribusiness conglomerate, has distanced itself and its senior chairman Dhanin Chearavanont from the controversial patents registered for new varieties of holy basil, a popular herb in Thai cuisine.
title_cn: 正大集团与董事长澄清与圣罗勒专利无关
summary_cn: 泰国最大农业综合企业正大集团（CP）及其资深董事长谢瓦那翁（Dhanin Chearavanont）宣布与有争议的圣罗勒新品种专利无关。这种草本植物在泰国料理中广泛使用。集团此举意在消除与相关专利争议的关联，以保护企业形象。
desc_original: Charoen Pokphand Group (CP), the country’s largest agribusiness conglomerate, has distanced itself and its senior chairman Dhanin Chearavanont from the controversial patents registered for new varieties of holy basil, a popular herb in Thai cuisine.

title: Thailand clarifies new baggage inspection rules after complaints
desc: Thailand clarifies new baggage inspection rules after complaints Legacy The Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT) clarified its new baggage inspection rules today, October 25, confirming that searches are only permitted when X-ray scans detect suspicious items . The rules, introduced on October 16, allow only authorised airport personnel to open checked luggage when X-ray screening raises concerns about prohibited items or potential aviation safety risks. CAAT stressed that officers cannot routinely open every bag. The most commonly detected prohibited items include power banks and battery-powered electronic devices, which can pose fire and short-circuit risks if packed or transported incorrectly, particularly in an aircraft’s cargo hold. When an X-ray scan identifies a suspicious item, the luggage is taken to a designated inspection area, where authorised officers can open it for further examination. The inspection must be recorded on camera for later review, and officers must place a Notice of Baggage Inspection inside the luggage to inform the passenger that it has been searched. title: Greek driver gets pickup stuck on Jomtien Beach as tide rises
desc: Greek driver gets pickup stuck on Jomtien Beach as tide rises Legacy A Greek man drove his pickup truck onto Jomtien Beach in Pattaya to test whether it could pull a jet ski out of the sea , only for the vehicle to become stuck in the sand as the tide rose yesterday, October 24. Pattaya City special affairs officers received a report of the stranded vehicle at 3.36am and arrived to find a silver pickup truck stuck on Jomtien Beach in Nong Prue subdistrict, Bang Lamung district. title: Royal Barge Procession final rehearsal opens to public on October 28
desc: Royal Barge Procession final rehearsal opens to public on October 28 Legacy The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) has invited the public to watch the final full dress rehearsal of the Royal Barge Procession in Bangkok on Wednesday, October 28. The procession will set off from Rama VIII Bridge at 3pm and finish at Wat Arun Ratchawararam. The rehearsal comes ahead of the royal kathin robe offering at Wat Arun on Friday, November 6, which His Majesty the King and Queen Suthida will attend. The procession also forms part of the celebrations for Queen Suthida’s fourth cycle (48th) birthday, which fell on June 3. The Royal Thai Navy has picked 2,200 personnel from various units to crew the royal barges. A total of 52 barges will take part, arranged in five columns that stretch 1,200 metres long and 90 metres wide. On the Thonburi side of the Chao Phraya River, the public can watch from under Rama VIII Bridge near the King Rama VIII Monument, Chaloem Phra Kiat 72 Phansa Park beside Siriraj Hospital, the Wat Rakhang Kositaram pier and Wat Arun itself. On the Phra Nakhon side, viewing points include Santichaiprakan Park next to Phra Sumen Fort, Tha Maharaj, Tha Chang and Nagaraphirom Park
title_cn: 皇家驳船巡游最后彩排10月28日向公众开放

title: Customs log 40 cannabis arrests in 24 days, Indians top arrest list
desc: Customs log 40 cannabis arrests in 24 days, Indians top arrest list Legacy Thai customs arrested 40 people and seized 577 kilogrammes of cannabis flowers worth 5.8 million baht at Suvarnabhumi Airport from October 1 to 24, with Indian nationals accounting for the most arrests . The Customs Department announced the cannabis seizures today, October 25, saying most of those arrested were foreign nationals attempting to take cannabis flowers out of the country without permission. Of those arrested, 11 were Indian nationals, followed by seven Chinese and five British nationals. Other travellers came from Canada, Spain, Portugal and elsewhere in Europe and the Americas. title: Immigration police bust K-pod factory in Bangkok hotel room
desc: Immigration police bust K-pod factory in Bangkok hotel room Legacy Immigration Bureau police arrested five Vietnamese nationals in Bangkok’s Pratunam area yesterday, October 24, and seized 3,200 K-pods , vape pods that tested positive for the anaesthetic etomidate. Officers from Immigration Division 1 had been targeting a Vietnamese man nicknamed Suea, who police said sells K-pods in the capital. An undercover informant arranged to buy about 3,000 pods from Suea, with the handover set for a condominium in Pratunam. Police said each pod sells for about 1,500 baht on the market, putting the total at more than 5 million baht (US$148,000). Suea arrived early in the evening with two other Vietnamese men. He then called fellow gang members to ride motorcycles to the area, and two more men arrived with the pods to show the informant. Once the informant confirmed the pods were genuine, officers waiting nearby moved in and arrested all five. A preliminary test kit detected etomidate, a category 2 psychotropic substance, in the pods. The suspects were charged with jointly producing, importing, exporting, selling or possessing a category 2 psychotropic substance without permission. Penalties
